cases.prompt: Among the people who've sent at least 20 messages in <GROUP>, who gets the most reactions per message?
cases.grader_notes: The one question only get_chat_participant_stats answers: get_group_dynamics has no reactions-received section, so routing to it (or to get_reaction_stats, which is scoped to me, not per-member) = routing 0. GT normalizes reactions_received by messages_sent over the members with >= 20 messages sent -- the floor the prompt states, so applying it is part of the task, not a hidden convention. A raw-total answer that ignores per-message normalization = accuracy 0, as is one that ranks members below the floor. raw.rates is the full computed leaderboard: if the reply names GT's runner-up and the two rates are close, weigh the arithmetic in the reply rather than the name alone.
